conditions.condition_text: Identify the most recent support or resistance zone on the 4H or 1H timeframe.
The zone represents the most recent area of uncertainty.
Wait for the candlestick on the HTF to close outside of the identified support or resistance zone.
The body of the candlestick must close outside the zone, not just the wick.
Drop to the 1M chart and wait for price to pull back into the previous resistance or support zone.
The pullback into the zone is the setup for the entry trigger.
Wait for price to form consolidation, a higher high/lower low structure change, or a trend line break within the zone.
This confirms the reversal intent or continuation bias.
Enter the trade at the break of the consolidation, trend line, or recent high/low.
The break confirms the entry trigger.
The trade must be initiated by identifying the most recent support or resistance zone on the 4H or 1H timeframe.
The HTF candle must close outside of the identified support or resistance zone.
Price must pull back into the previous resistance or support zone on the 1M chart.
The LTF must show consolidation, a higher high/lower low, or a trend line break.
The stop loss is placed below the most recent higher low for buys, or above the most recent lower high for sells.
The target is set at the next major high or low on the HTF.
